programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: It's the school play and Lola is determined to be The Sun.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Lola and her friend, Lotta, know everything there is to know about dogs. So they're really pleased when Marv lets them look after his dog, Sizzles, in the park.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Lola simply has to win all of the time. She can run faster than a cheetah, she can bounce higher than a kangaroo and she can stand on one leg for longer than a flamingo!

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: It's that time when Charlie and Lola have to get their haircut. But something's bothering Lola and she doesn't want to tell us what it is...

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Charlie has promised Marv that he'll play football with him but poor Lola has a very nasty cold and is stuck in bed.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Charlie wants Lola to hurry or they'll be late for school. But there are so many exciting things to do on the way that Lola keeps getting distracted.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: It's ever so easy for Charlie to make Lola jump. But what Lola wants more than anything is to make Charlie jump.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: You can't have a picnic without swirly tennis and boildy eggs and of course sunshine. Lola, Lotta, Charlie and Marv are really excited because they have all of those things!

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Charlie wins first prize at school for his fantastic homemade rocket which he made from 10 yoghurt pots and some extra wide tin foil.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Lola has to keep Charlie's birthday surprise a big secret. And it's really, really hard to keep secrets!

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Granny and Grandpa's house is by the sea where there are pony rides, lovely things to eat, a dressing up box and Caspar the Cat but Lola is worried that Soren Lorenson might miss her while she's away!

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Lola is horrified because she has her first ever wobbly tooth and she does not ever, never want her wobbly tooth to fall out.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: To please Mum, Lola is determined to stay clean and tidy for her very first school photograph. And Lola's not very good at staying clean and tidy!

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Lola likes all sorts of creepy crawlies, she's just not keen on spiders. Charlie tries to show Lola that spiders aren't bad at all, in fact they're really quite clever.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Snow is on the way and Lola is bursting with excitement. Lola loves snow. After she finally gets to sleep, she wakes up the next morning to find that everything has gone completely, extremely white!

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: It's Lotta's birthday and of course, Lola wants to buy her friend the very best present in the whole wide world. She is over the moon when she finds the very thing... a Doctor's kit!

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Lola is packing to go to Lotta's for the night. And she is packing everything because her and Lotta are going to play Cinderella! Disaster strikes when Lola realises she has left her suitcase at home!

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Introducing Charlie on clarinet and Marv on keyboards! The boys are presenting a piece all about Outer Space accompanied with music in front of the whole school tomorrow in assembly.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Lola simply doesn't have time to play today; she's far too extremely busy organising her office full of mermaids, running her own café, dentist and library.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Life's just not fair when you're always the smaller one... you can't go to bed late, you can't get your own pink milk and you can't go on the Super Dooper Loop the Looper ride at the fair.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Sharing the "My Little Town" play set that Granny and Grandpa gave them proves a bit of a challenge for Charlie and Lola.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Dressing up is one of Lola's absolutely favourite things to do and now she's got this fabulous new alligator costume, she's not ever going to take it off... not ever! Snap! Snap! Snap!

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Lola just won't tidy up the bedroom. Try as he might, Charlie simply can't persuade her that a tidy room is a good thing.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: When Charlie goes out with Marv, Lola decides to play "Spies" with her imaginary friend, Soren Lorenson.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Charlie is Magic. Lola knows this for a fact. He has a new magic set and has been practising to great effect. Lola wants to be magic too. But poor Lola just can't get the knack of it!

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Lola wants to make Charlie's birthday party the best party anyone could ever have. The problem is that Lola's idea of a good party isn't anything like Charlie's.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Long car journeys and rainy days can be pretty boring, but a dentist waiting rooms where there is absolutely nothing to do is definitely the most boring place of all!

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: What if every person in the world were just waiting for their call to be taken, their life always on hold? Garfield is about to find out.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Garfield has always stayed away from cat food, opting instead for people food. After seeing his stray cat friends being fed some, he remembers how that came to be.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: When the leader of the lasagna planet, Parma, sends in a spy in the form of a cuter version of Nermal to gain information on Garfield's weakness, his mission to invade the planet may be compromised...

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Garfield and Odie have their own undersea adventure when a giant squid takes Odie and starts wreaking havoc in the city sewers.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: It's the tale of Penny Henny, revisited, as Jon tells the story of the chicken who believed the sky was falling all because of one orange cat.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: When Jon unleashes a trickster genie in a bottle, he gets the tables turned on him and must grant the genie his three wishes lest he be turned into a frog.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Shrimpy the Elephant is being mistreated by Dr. Whipple. When he escapes, it's up to Garfield to help him stay hidden.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Captain Garfield's ship is under attack by a group of rival pirates, Rottweiller, Hercules and Wilfred, who are after his treasure.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Things soon get out of hand when Garfield gets his paws on Dr. Bonkers cloning ray.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Garfield puts Vito's skill and patience to the test when he hatches up a plan to exploit Vito's "pizza delivery under 20 minutes or else the pizza is free" offer.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: When Odie swallows a Mexican jumping bean, he becomes a doggy bouncing ball and takes Garfield for a wild ride all over the town.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Jon is taken by the police when he is wrongly accused of stealing Mrs. Shmidlap's bracelet. It's up to Odie to find out what really happened.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Bruno, an alley cat, is sick and tired of watching Garfield get waited on hand and foot while he has to live in a trash can. And so he decides to make Garfield's home his own.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Could this be the end of Vito's Pizzeria? Garfield must save the two loves of Vito's life from the hands of Brent Mogul, real estate tycoon.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Dr. Goodiegoodie, an old TV show Jon used to watch, is no ordinary show. It's the show that watches you. When Dr. Goodiegoodie sees Garfield being mean to Nermal, he decides to punish him...

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Paddy the Leprechaun has brought the rain with him and ruined Jon and Liz's trip to the beach. Garfield and Odie think they're saved from the clutches of Aunt Ivy.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Squeak has the power to see the future. How you may ask? Garfield doesn't care so long as he can make big bucks off of it. But when's Squeak's new "power" suddenly runs out, it's Jon on the line!

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Garfield is preparing for hibernation. But sleeping for months when you live with others isn't so easy after all, especially when they can get you into trouble without you even knowing!

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Garfield and Odie show the pampered and spoiled, but lonely Prince Orloff what fun and playing is all about. Or at least Odie does, while Garfield watches.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: When a mole's tunnel collapses Jon's yard, affecting Garfield's friends, the strays, and squirrels, Garfield comes up with a master plan that just might solve everyone's problems.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Jon is birdsitting his editor's parrot, Paxton, while Odie is away. But soon Paxton's doom and gloom attitude is bringing everyone down. Not even Garfield can help him but maybe someone else can...

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: There's something very strange going on with the weather in town when it starts to rain sandwiches after a massive heatwave.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Jon, Odie, Garfield, and the twin follow what seems to be the source of the bizarre weather: a single cloud. It leads them to something and someone they could never have imagined.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: There is a space invasion under Jon Arbuckle's roof, and the aliens are looking very much like Garfield's favourite meal: lasagnas.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Squeak and his mice family have taken up residence in Garfield's house, to Jon's despair, who will deprive Garfield of lasagnas if he doesn't turn things back to normal.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Garfield's favourite restaurant, Vito's Pizzeria, is in jeopardy. The evil Mama Meany wants to buy it to expand his own restaurant, with the PizzaGrand 7000 capable of making ten pizzas a minute.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: A mother bluebird is locked in a neighbourhood garage, so who will care for her eggs? That's a job for Garfield, who is sometimes quite a mother hen.

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: The Cat brings Sally and Nick to meet some great sneaker-uppers - cats! Later, Nick and Sally are making their 'Best Ever Yummy For Your Tummy' muffins when they realise they don't have enough flour.

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: Sally and Nick are planning to camp out in the backyard but there are some scary noises out there! Later, Nick and Sally plan to make a leaf collage of Cat.

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: Sally and Nick are getting their hair cut today; maybe they should try new hairstyles! Later, Nick and Sally want some nice cold lemonade but there's no more ice cubes in Sally's fridge!

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: Sally and Nick are trying to guess what they'll be when they grow up when the Cat drops in for a visit. Later, Nick and Sally can't seem to find Harvey the Guinea Pig.

programs.desc: For Show and Tell at school, Nick and Sally must bring something from their favourite season. But how can they choose which is their favourite?

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: Nick and Sally try to jump high enough to touch the moon, but "what goes up must come down" says the Cat. Then, Sally and Nick play hide and seek, but Nick keeps sneezing!

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: Nick keeps trying to surprise Sally, but he just can't do it! The Cat takes them to find a real surprise in the Skippylarito Fields! Then, the kids hear chirping but can't find where it's coming from.

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: Nick and Sally wonder why their ball is so bouncy. Then, Nick and Sally are playing on a climbing frame but just can't manage to get to the top.

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: Nick and Sally want to keep playing, but it's getting dark. Why does nighttime have to come? The Cat knows someone who can answer that question. Then, the kids visit Muddymoo River.

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: Nick and Sally must protect their cookie jar from cookie snatchers! Then, the kids meet Treetop Tom and see how his tough tongue can pick food off of thorny branches.

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: Sally and Nick are pretending to swim but "why not go for a real swim" asks the Cat! Later, the children go on a trip to visit Princess Lottachoca in the Cocoalicious Forest.

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: Nick and Sally are try to guess what animal is the toughest one. Then, the Cat needs to get his fish friend, Ting Tang Tony, back to his family.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Charlie and Lola's well rehearsed circus act for Granny and Grandpa is put in jeopardy when poor Charlie breaks his arm playing football with Marv.

programs.desc: It's Lola's first ever school sport's day and, after much deliberation, she decides to enter the Egg and Spoon race - the most difficult race of all.

programs.desc: Mrs Hanson has chosen Lola to look after Bert, the class guinea pig, for the school holidays.

programs.desc: Charlie and Marv are trying to do their Spanish homework which sparks an interest in Lola to speak Spanish too.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Lola isn't scared of the dark; she just wants the bedroom door open, the window blind up and the light on... that's all!

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Marv and Charlie are off to the insect house and Marv's little brother, Morton, is coming round to play with Lola. Lola is very excited and is sure that Morton will be her new friend!

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Charlie and Lola are on a recycling mission. Soon, they involve the whole school, determined to enter a competition that could win them all a real tree to plant! But time is running out...

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Charlie and Lola love Charlie's pet mouse, Nibbles. But mice don't live for very long and when Nibbles dies, Lola doesn't think she could ever have a pet mouse again.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Everybody in the whole school has to make a picture of their house for open visiting school day. Charlie, Marv, Lola and Lotta all decide to make their pictures round at Charlie and Lola's.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Lola is in a superstitious mood. There are so many unlucky things you can do. Charlie plays along but Lola's imagination gets carried away. If you step on the cracks, do bears really jump out at you?

programs.desc: Usually Lola just loves going to school but recently she is not so keen. It's all the counting and the writing and the reading. Especially the reading. Poor Lola is feeling the pressure.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Lola is going to have her eyes tested at the optician's but she's not at all keen.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Lola is going to Lotta's house for her first ever sleepover and it couldn't be more exciting. But, little by little, Lola realises everything is a bit different from her normal bedtime.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Outside the weather is extremely and absolutely boiling hot. Lola, Charlie and Arnold Wolf (from next door) try to cool down with fanning, panting and then ice creams.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Marv's Mum says Sizzles really is a very naughty dog but Lola knows this isn't true. Sizzles just needs some practice! Charlie and Lola take Sizzles back to their flat and set about "training" him.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Lola and Lotta both love their tricycles but when Lotta is given her big cousin's bike, Lola wants a big bike too. She gets Charlie's old one and is delighted.

programs.desc: Odie falls in love with a brush. Garfield becomes a little bit jealous about that and decides to make the brush disappear.

programs.desc: Jon has won a live turkey in a raffle and wants to prepare it for dinner, but he can't make up his mind to eat it. Neither can Garfield!

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Garfield is angry. A fake, secret agent is trying to steal the show and his popularity among his friends.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Who has stolen Pooky? After a night drying on the clothes line, Pooky has disappeared, and Garfield can't sleep without him.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: It's night-time and the full moon and the alignment of the planets are having a strange effect on Odie.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Liz's parents are coming over to meet Jon and Jon really has to make a good impression.

programs.title: The Garfield Show

programs.desc: A salesman has sold Jon a cleaning Robot, which is very annoying to his two pets.

programs.desc: Garfield is really unhappy because he has to be on diet. And he's having nightmares about it.

programs.desc: Jon can't manage to sleep. He's tried everything, to no avail. But Dr. Somnambulo has a new machine: the hypno-doron, still in work-in-progress.

programs.desc: Liz brings back an old mirror from her travels in Egypt. This one is enchanted and opens a door towards ancient Egypt where a Goddess, Neferkitty, has a secret wish: conquering the human world.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Two little devilish girls are coming visiting Jon. They really want to play dolls with Garfield and Odie, who only want to stay clear from them.

programs.desc: Garfield is stuck in a parallel world where cats have taken the place of humans, and vice versa!

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Jon sends Garfield to Dr Whipple's Show in order for him to learn how to be a well-behaved cat.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Garfield accidentally climbs into an outer space traveller's car, which sends him into parallel worlds.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Sir Leo, a famous TV Actor, looks very much like Garfield. So when he has to go on vacations, Garfield takes his place and gets to taste celebrity and glitter.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Our heroes are on a fishing trip. Odie saves a little fish and goes to explore the underwater world with Garfield.
